verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official UCP CLI (@shopify/ucp-cli), an AI Toolkit plugin, and MCP/JSON-RPC endpoints, but no official language SDK or client library for building against Shopify Agentic Commerce. The CLI and MCP servers are adjacent surfaces rather than SDKs, and the UCP reference implementations on GitHub belong to the protocol body and are not described as Shopify SDKs, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
